stemMd: Which point lies on both the $x$-axis and the line $4x-3y=28$?
explanationMd: A point on the x-axis has y=0. Then 4x=28, so x=7. The intercept is therefore (7,0).

distractorRationale.b: This swaps the coordinates and does not satisfy the line.
distractorRationale.a: This is the y-intercept, not a point on the x-axis.
